threat_summary: A user downloads an unusually large number of files from a SaaS platform.
key_behaviors: SaaS activity volume is far above user baseline
activity follows unusual authentication or device context
downloaded files or accessed resources may contain sensitive data
mitre_mapping: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
hunt_checklist: Search relevant telemetry for: SaaS activity volume is far above user baseline.
Search relevant telemetry for: activity follows unusual authentication or device context.
Search relevant telemetry for: downloaded files or accessed resources may contain sensitive data.
Correlate activity by user, host, source IP, destination, and time window.
Confirm whether the behavior is expected business activity before escalation.
correlation_logic: Correlate alert evidence across listed telemetry sources within the same user, host, source IP, destination, and 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when mass file download from saas is confirmed on a real user, host, workload, or production asset and the behavior cannot be explained by approved business activity.
